facts.fact: 开篇：她想象母亲与 Leah 见面——这件事从未真的发生过。
facts.anchor: Sometimes, I imagine my mother and Leah meeting, though this is not a thing which ever actually happened.

facts.fact: 清晨抵达母亲家：地上白雾像绊线，Juna 开车。
facts.anchor: We arrive in the early morning – white mist on the ground like a tripwire, my mother’s house

facts.fact: 她们把 Leah 弄进屋里，抬到母亲的浴室，往浴缸里倒盐水。
facts.anchor: We get Leah in, somehow, move her up to my mother’s bathroom, where I pour the salt water

facts.fact: Juna 说船浮上来时船上只有 Leah 与另一名船员，连那人的名字与状况都不清楚。
facts.anchor: only Leah and one other crew member were aboard, that she isn’t sure of the other crew member’s name

facts.fact: Juna 认定另外那些人遭遇的和 Leah 一样，或者正在经历。
facts.anchor: I have to assume the same happened to them as Leah,” she says, “or is happening to them.

facts.fact: 中心用一封信通知 Juna 她妹妹在潜水途中「意外死亡」，并称按规程尸体已在水下被弹出船外。
facts.anchor: the Centre informed her via letter of her sister’s accidental death during the course of the dive

facts.fact: 她列了一份「没地方放进去的事」：跟着 Alone by Heart 对口型逗 Leah 笑、Leah 的手与金发、狼人般的眉毛等等。
facts.anchor: Here are some things I didn’t have space for:

facts.fact: 第二天早上她重新浸湿毛巾、把 Leah 裹好抬下楼，抱她走向海；毛巾散开后，剩下的是空气、水，和夹在中间的她。
facts.anchor: What persists after this is only air and water and me between them, not quite either
